title: plugin-list/kanban: switching to the kanban view issues the identical records fetch twice on mount
body:
Measured by the PM in the console's network log on 2026-09-02 (showcase Tasks → All Views page → 看板): the view switch issued `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task?top=100&select=id,title,assignee,status,priority,due_date,cover,start_date,end_date,created_at,progress,location,estimate_hours,done` twice back-to-back (request ids 47553.440 and 47553.442) before the first paint; a later PATCH (drag) triggered a single refetch, so the duplicate is a mount-time effect, not the DnD path.

Not re-verified by a dev yet (the objectui#7249 dispatch declined to file unverified sibling claims); filed on the PM's own reading as a `finding` for triage. A production Vite build was used, so this is not a StrictMode double-effect.
